reviewed_native_root_causes: The checked-in Chromium Cargo configuration omits SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT, which pinned Chromium enables. An isolated build adds that single flag without repinning Skia or modifying renderer source and repairs native arrow sampling.
The independent composited corner needs exterior coverage at a fractional physical origin; a shared AA fill repairs the last 27 native corner pixels after the shader configuration correction.
